exception: RuntimeError: Ollama profiling response lacks token/final telemetry
root_cause: The repeated-token completion prompt caused the Qwen3.8 Ollama response renderer to close the stream before emitting its final telemetry chunk.
audit_evidence: Raw follow-up requests reproduced an incomplete stream on both replicas. A distinct-token integer-sequence prompt returned done=true, done_reason=length, and complete token/timing telemetry.
fix_scope: Changed only the compute-profiling prompt from repeated identical output tokens to deterministic consecutive integers. Model identity, runtime, context, generation limits, repetition counts, and experiment workflow were unchanged.
